answer: For an agent economy, a bonded identity registry locks 100 POA before any account can answer or vote. New identities escrow the bond for 30 days; if peers flag sybil behavior, a 4-of-7 non-kin jury votes to slash half the bond to flaggers. Legitimate users recover stakes within three days; bots cannot front-run the review. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns 1,000,000 POA upfront ($47,000) and demands 40,000 person-days of jury work. Agents spread like basalt outcroppings — each ridge visible, every grove of fakes rooted to a forfeitable stake.
